parameters: \bI'm learning about bikes while\nI work here.
\bIf you need advice on how to ride your\nbike, there're a couple handbooks in\nthe back.
It's a handbook on the Mach Bike.
Which page do you want to read?
A bike moves in the direction that\nthe + Control Pad is pressed.
It will speed up once it gets rolling.
To stop, release the + Control Pad.\nThe bike will slow to a stop.
Want to read a different page?
A Mach Bike is speedy, but it can't\nstop very quickly.
It gets a little tricky to get around\na corner.
Release the + Control Pad a little\nbefore the corner and slow down.
Want to read a different page?
There are small sandy slopes\nthroughout the Hoenn region.
The loose, crumbly sand makes it\nimpossible to climb normally.
But if you have a Mach Bike, you can\nzip up a sandy slope.
Want to read a different page?
It's a handbook on the Acro Bike.
Which page do you want to read?
Press the B Button while riding,\nand the front wheel lifts up.
You can zip around with the front\nwheel up using the + Control Pad.
This technique is called a wheelie.
Want to read a different page?
Keeping the B Button pressed,\nyour bike can hop on the spot.
This technique is called a bunny hop.
You can ride while hopping, too.
Want to read a different page?
Press the B Button and the + Control\nPad at the same time to jump.
Press the + Control Pad to the side\nto jump sideways.
Press it backwards to make the bike\nchange directions while jumping.
Want to read a different page?
\bWell, well, what have we here?\nA most energetic customer!
\bMe? You may call me Rydel.\nI'm the owner of this cycle shop.
\bYou're saying that you came all this\nway from Littleroot?
\bIf you had one of my bikes, you could\ngo anywhere easily while feeling the\ngentle caress of the wind!
\bI'll tell you what!\nI'll give you a bike!
\bI forgot to tell you that there are\ntwo kinds of bikes!
\bThey are the Mach Bike and\nthe Acro Bike!
\bThe Mach Bike is for cyclists who want\nto feel the wind with their bodies!
\bAnd an Acro Bike is for those who\nprefer technical rides!
\bI'm a real sweetheart, so you can\nhave whichever one you like!
\bRydel: If you get the urge to switch\nbikes, just come see me!
